purpose: Dynamic training against standard ParT training on train800k, with members and checkpoints selected on sel1m_tail (1M jets from the train8m rows that train800k does not use) instead of val50k_tail (150k jets). Three arms per seed, seeds 12345 and 22345: standard ParT (Weaver flat+decay restarted from the epoch-17 checkpoint, start LRs 1e-5 to 1e-3), a constant-LR grid around the optimum (6e-5 to 1.6e-4), and the fast windowed PBT with fallback copies. Each arm contributes its validation-selected checkpoint (global best on sel1m_tail). Primary comparison: fast PBT against standard ParT, per seed. Secondary: fast PBT against the constant-LR grid, and the constant-LR grid against standard ParT.
